킹 케이지(King Cage)는 1991년 론 앤드루스(Ron Andre: King Cage is a water bottle cage workshop founded by Ron Andrews in 1991. He was making tools and machines in a frame shop when a customer asked for a bottle cage made from titanium, and the first titanium cage that came out of it was named the King Cage. He expected dealers to laugh at it. Instead, orders started coming in, and in 1996 a stainless steel cage joined the line.
지금도 모든 케이지는 콜로라도 듀랑고(Durango)에 있는 론의 집 지: Every cage is still made in the basement shop at Ron's home in Durango, Colorado. All materials are sourced in the USA, and cutting, bending, welding and finishing are shared between family and a few crew members. These are not stamped out by a factory; each one is bent on jigs and machines that people built by hand.
첫 티타늄 물통 케이지가 나온 해: The year the first titanium bottle cage was made

미국산 티타늄과 스테인리스만 쓰는 소재: Only USA-sourced titanium and stainless steel

킹 케이지의 모양은 처음부터 거의 바뀌지 않았습니다. 물통 입구의 홈을: The King Cage shape has barely changed since the beginning. The top presses down on the groove below the bottle's neck, so the bottle stays put even on rough roads. The stainless steel cage won't leave black marks on your bottle, and its joints are now laser welded for smaller, more even welds.
무게만 좇는 케이지는 아닙니다. 물통을 잃어버리지 않는 것, 오래 타도: These are not cages that chase grams alone. They don't lose your bottle, they don't break after years of riding, and they look right on any bike. That is why you see King Cages both on custom frame builders' show bikes and on everyday commuters.
1991년 한 손님의 부탁으로 만든 첫 티타늄 물통 케이지. 지금도 같은: The first titanium bottle cage, made in 1991 at a customer's request. Still made in the same shape today.
티타늄과 같은 모양을 스테인리스로. 물통에 자국을 남기지 않고, 이음매는: The same shape in stainless steel. It won't mark your bottle, and the joints are laser welded.
튜브를 자르고 구부리는 기계와 지그도 론이 직접 만들었습니다. 일주일에: Ron built the machines and jigs that cut and bend the tubing himself. The shop makes hundreds of cages a week this way.
A family workshop where Ron's wife Shari handles packing and shipping and his daughter Taiya looks after customers. The crew are Durango riders too.
“판매점들이 웃거나 전화를 끊을 줄 알았습니다. 그런데 몇 곳은 주문을: “We thought dealers would laugh or hang up on us. Instead, some of them placed orders.”
론 앤드루스는 팀 팻 챈스(Team Fat Chance) 소속으로 미국: Ron Andrews raced mountain bikes on the East Coast with Team Fat Chance. Off the bike, he used his engineering degree at Fat City Cycles and Ibis to streamline production for small frame makers, and went on to work at Merlin, Joe Breeze and Yeti, right at the heart of American handmade bicycles.
1990년 매사추세츠 서머빌에서 원오프 티타늄(One-Off Titani: In 1990 he was sharing a shop in Somerville, Massachusetts with Mike Augspurger of One-Off Titanium, making tools and machines, when a customer asked for a titanium bottle cage. Using titanium for a bottle cage was an unconventional and tricky idea at the time, but Ron pulled it off.
1992년 예티에서 일하기 위해 듀랑고로 옮긴 뒤에도 낮에는 프레임을,: After moving to Durango in 1992 to work for Yeti, he built frames by day and cages in his garage by night. That garage is today's King Cage shop. At the North American Handmade Bicycle Show (NAHBS), his booth always drew a crowd watching him bend tubes on the spot.
론 앤드루스 (Ron Andrews), 킹 케이지 창립자: Ron Andrews, founder of King Cage

1991년의 첫 케이지. 가볍고 단단한 티타늄 튜브를 손으로 구부린 기본: The first cage from 1991. The basic form, hand-bent from light, strong titanium tubing.
The same shape in stainless steel. Laser-welded joints.
조금 더 꽉 잡는 우아한 곡선. 금속 물통과 다운튜브 장착에 좋은 케이지: An elegant curve with a slightly tighter grip. Great for metal bottles and down tube mounting.
A flat top so it takes bottles beyond cycling bottles.
A side-entry cage. The answer for full-suspension bikes and small frames.
The same cage with the bottle height changed. For frame bags and small frames.
A titanium cargo cage that carries big bottles, tents and sleeping bags on your fork.
Mounts that make room for a cage, and small things made from titanium.

스탠다드 케이지는 킹 케이지의 기준입니다. 티타늄 케이지는 1991년 처: The standard cage is the King Cage benchmark. Since its introduction in 1991, the titanium cage has set the standard for durability and design, and the stainless steel cage has been made in virtually the same shape since 1996. Both are hand-bent and welded, holding the bottle firmly on any road and any ride.
티타늄은 가볍고 녹슬지 않습니다. 스테인리스는 같은 모양을 더 합리적인: Titanium is light and won't rust. Stainless steel offers the same shape at a friendlier price, now with laser-welded joints that are smaller and more even. Both fit standard cycling bottles best.
케이지 윗부분이 물통 입구 아래의 홈을 눌러 잡습니다. 그래블과 MTB의: The top of the cage presses on the groove below the bottle's neck. Even on gravel and MTB trails, the bottle doesn't jump out.
론이 직접 만든 지그와 기계로 튜브를 한 단계씩 구부립니다. 공장에서 찍: The tubing is bent step by step on jigs and machines Ron built himself. Not stamped out by a factory, but touched by human hands.
티타늄과 스테인리스 모두 미국에서 들여온 소재만 씁니다. 티타늄 케이지에: Both titanium and stainless steel are sourced only in the USA. Titanium cages are stamped King Cage Titanium.
스테인리스와 티타늄 모두 물통에 검은 자국을 남기지 않습니다. 오래 써도: Neither stainless steel nor titanium leaves black marks on your bottle. Bottle and cage both stay clean for years.
킹 케이지의 이름이 된 첫 케이지. 가장 가볍고, 가장 오래 쓰는 케이지: The first cage, which gave King Cage its name. The lightest and longest-lasting cage. At home on any bike, from road and touring to custom builds.
티타늄과 같은 모양을 스테인리스로 만든 케이지. 레이저 용접으로 이음매를: The titanium shape made in stainless steel, with neatly laser-welded joints. The easiest choice for your first King Cage.
가벼운데, 놓치지 않습니다: Light, and it never lets go
티타늄 케이지는 가볍지만 물통을 헐겁게 잡지 않습니다. 케이지의 탄성이: The titanium cage is light but never holds the bottle loosely. The cage's spring wraps the bottle and the top locks it into the groove. Weight-conscious road riders and riders who don't want to lose a bottle on rough roads love it for the same reason.
The natural titanium colour suits any frame, steel, titanium or carbon. Once fitted, it is the cage that moves with you to your next bike.

Cycling bottles
and metal bottles,
in one cage.
요즘은 사이클링 물통 대신 스테인리스 보온병이나 금속 물통을 들고 타는: More and more riders carry an insulated stainless bottle or a metal bottle instead of a cycling bottle. Iris and Flat Top are made for them. Beyond standard cycling bottles, they take metal bottles with a base of 2.9 inches (about 74mm). King Cage lists the Mover 18oz Purist, Klean Kanteen and Hydro Flask as examples.
아이리스는 일반 케이지보다 조금 더 꽉 잡도록 설계해, 물통이 비스듬히: Iris is designed to grip a little tighter than a standard cage, which makes it especially secure on the down tube where the bottle hangs at an angle. Flat Top keeps the standard cage shape and only flattens the top, so it takes bottles without a neck groove.
속이 찬 티타늄 로드로 만든 아이리스. 아이리스의 곡선은 튜브로는 구부릴: The Iris in solid titanium rod. Its curve can't be bent from tubing, so it uses solid rod. It weighs about the same as the stainless version, but it is incredibly strong.
듀랑고 작업실에서 정밀 가공한 스테인리스 아이리스. 물통에 검은 자국을: A stainless Iris precision-made in the Durango shop. It won't leave black marks on your bottle and grips a little tighter.
스탠다드 티타늄 케이지의 모양에 평평한 윗부분. 가장 가볍게 금속 물통까: The standard titanium cage shape with a flat top. The lightest way to carry a metal bottle.
스테인리스 보틀 로어링 케이지에 플랫 탑을 더했습니다. 금속 물통을 받으: The stainless Bottle Lowering cage with a flat top. It takes metal bottles and sits the bottle about 1.1 inches lower.
금속 물통을 쓸 때 알아둘 것: Before you use a metal bottle
사이클링 물통이 아닌 물통을 쓸 때는 바닥 지름이 3인치(약 76mm)보: For non-cycling bottles, the base must be less than 3 inches (about 76mm). For bigger Nalgenes or large insulated bottles, the Manything Cage is the right fit.
아이리스와 플랫 탑은 물통을 단단히 잡는 만큼, 도장된 금속 물통은 케이: Because Iris and Flat Top hold the bottle firmly, painted metal bottles may get scratched where they touch the cage. Unpainted stainless bottles and cycling bottles are no concern.
사이드 로더 · 보틀 로어링 · 보틀 레이징: Side Loader · Bottle Lowering · Bottle Raising
For bikes with
little room for a bottle.
풀서스펜션 MTB, 작은 사이즈 프레임, 미니벨로, 프레임백을 단 투어링: Full-suspension MTBs, small frames, minivelos, touring bikes with frame bags. When there is little room inside the frame, pulling a bottle straight up gets hard. King Cage solves this by changing the direction and height of the same cage.
사이드 로더(Side Loader)는 물통을 옆으로 넣고 빼는 케이지입니: The Side Loader lets you put the bottle in and take it out from the side. It mounts left, right or center as you prefer, and even with side entry the bottle stays centered on the frame and sticks out no more than a standard cage. Bottle Lowering sits the bottle about 1.1 inches (about 28mm) lower, and Bottle Raising sits it higher for easier access.
물통 입구 홈을 위에서 잡아 옆으로 꺼냅니다. 사이드 마운트로 달면 가운: It holds the bottle by the neck groove from above and releases it to the side. Mounted with the side mounts, the center mount is free to strap a tool or spare tire.
호스 클램프로 묶으면 케이지 볼트가 없는 자전거에도 달 수 있습니다. 왼: Attached with hose clamps, it fits even bikes without cage bolts. Left, right or center.
마운트 위치를 옮겨 물통을 약 1.1인치 낮게 답니다. 작은 프레임이나: The mount position moves to sit the bottle about 1.1 inches lower. Good for small frames or with a frame bag.
물통을 더 높게 달아 쉽게 꺼냅니다. 가장 아래 구멍의 중심이 물통 바닥: Sits the bottle higher for easier access. The center of the lowest hole lines up precisely with the bottom of the bottle.
세 케이지는 물통을 잡는 모양은 같고, 프레임에 닿는 마운트 위치만 다릅: The three cages hold the bottle in the same shape; only the mount position against the frame changes. The cage bolts stay where they are and only the bottle height moves.
탑튜브와 물통 사이가 좁아 물통이 걸린다면 로어링을, 물통이 너무 깊이: If the bottle catches between the top tube and the cage, choose Lowering. If it sits too deep to reach easily, choose Raising. Not sure which? Send a photo of your bike to Rubi Workshop.
Just as the name says,
a cage for
many things.
매니씽 케이지(Manything Cage)는 바이크패킹을 위한 티타늄 카: The Manything Cage is a titanium cargo cage for bikepacking. Big bottles like a Nalgene or a 40oz Klean Kanteen, tents and sleeping bags, pads and fuel all go on the fork or down tube. King Cage says it is even perfect for bringing a bottle of wine to dinner at a friend's house.
강도가 가장 높은 솔리드 로드와 더 가벼운 튜브, 두 가지 티타늄으로 만: It comes in two kinds of titanium, solid rod for maximum strength or hollow tube for less weight, with optional orange King Cage branded Voile straps. The Longer Thing Cage, made for longer loads, has one more mount to carry more weight.
큰 물통과 바이크패킹 짐을 위한 기본형. 세 개의 마운트 구멍에 모두 볼: The basic form for big bottles and bikepacking gear. We recommend a bolt in all three mount holes.
매니씽을 길게 늘린 버전. 텐트, 물통 두 개, 겹쳐 넣은 캠핑 쿡웨어,: An elongated Manything. Carries long loads: tents, two bottles, stacked camp cookware, even fishing rods.
스트랩은 함께 오는 1인치 오링 네 개로 케이지에 고정합니다. 오링은 E: Straps attach to the cage with the four 1-inch O-rings supplied. The O-rings are EPDM with a 25mm inner diameter, easy to replace.
스탠리 클래식 8oz 플라스크를 위한 스테인리스 케이지. 라이딩 끝의 한: A stainless cage for the Stanley Classic 8oz flask. For a sip at the end of the ride. Flask not included.
2리터의 물까지 시험했습니다: Tested with up to 2 liters of water
킹 케이지는 매니씽 케이지를 물 2리터 무게까지 시험했습니다. 실을 수: King Cage has tested the Manything Cage with up to 2 liters of water weight. How much it carries depends on how you ride, and it is especially good for light bikepacking gear like a pad or a lightweight tent. The Longer Thing, with one more mount, carries heavier loads.
모든 마운트 구멍에 볼트를 채워야 시험한 강도가 나옵니다. 포크에 구멍이: The tested strength depends on a bolt in every mount hole. If your fork is short of holes, back it up with a Universal Support Bolt.
탑캡 케이지 마운트 · 유니버설 서포트 볼트: Top Cap Cage Mount · Universal Support Bolt
No cage bolts?
Make a place for one.
탑캡 케이지 마운트(Top Cap Cage Mount)는 스템의 탑캡을: The Top Cap Cage Mount replaces your stem's top cap to put a cage in front of the bars. It is ideal when you want to drink without bending down, need an extra bottle, or have a frame too small for a cage. It fits most cages on any top cap style stem.
유니버설 서포트 볼트(Universal Support Bolt)는 볼트: The Universal Support Bolt is a clamp that mounts a cage on a tube with no bolt holes. From handlebars and seat stays to suspension forks and fat aluminum tubes, choose one of six sizes to match the diameter where it goes.
기존 탑캡 대신 끼우는 케이지 마운트. 설치가 간단하고, 핸들 앞에 물통: A cage mount that replaces your top cap. Easy to install, and the bottle sits in front of the bars where it is easy to grab while riding.
스테인리스 밴드 클램프에 케이지 볼트를 더한 마운트. 한 개씩 판매하며,: A stainless band clamp with a cage bolt. Sold individually; a cage usually needs two.
유니버설 서포트 볼트 크기는 최대 지름 기준입니다. 끈으로 장착할 자리의: Universal Support Bolt sizes are maximum diameters. Measure the circumference where it will go with a string and divide by 3.14 to get the diameter. 1 1/8 inch fits handlebars and seat stays (minimum diameter 3/4 inch), 1 3/8 inch steel frames and forks, 1 5/8 inch 32mm suspension forks, 2 inch aluminum tubes and 36mm suspension forks, and 2 1/4 and 2 1/2 inch larger tubes. Protect the frame with electrical tape or a cloth rim strip (avoid rubber inner tube, which can break the clamp), and do not use on tapered forks. If the clamp loosens even slightly, it can slide down into the wheel. Not recommended for mounting racks.
솔리드 티타늄 로드로 구부린 키링. 손에 잘 잡히고, 열쇠를 끼우고 빼기: A key ring bent from solid titanium rod. Comfortable in the hand, and easy to slide keys on and off.
티타늄으로 만든 타이어 레버. 무척 튼튼하지만 거칠게 쓰면 림에 흠이 날: Tire levers made from titanium. Very strong, but rough use can scratch your rims, so handle with care.
케이지와 같은 1/4인치 티타늄 튜브로 만든 빨대. 6인치 일자, 8인치: Straws made from the same 1/4-inch titanium tubing as the cages. 6-inch straight, 8-inch bent, 10-inch straight, cleaning brush included.
물통 케이지의 윗부분을 닮은 티타늄 병따개. 라이딩이 끝난 뒤의 작은 즐: A titanium bottle opener shaped like the top of a bottle cage. A small pleasure after the ride.
Choosing a cage
for your bottle and bike.
어떤 물통을 쓰는지, 프레임 안에 공간이 얼마나 있는지에 따라 고르면 됩: Choose by the bottle you carry and how much room there is inside your frame.
작은 프레임, 프레임백을 함께 쓸 때 (약 1.1인치 낮게): Small frames, with a frame bag (about 1.1 in lower)
표준 물통, 바닥 지름 2.9인치 금속 물통: Standard bottles, metal bottles with a 2.9 in base
다운튜브 장착, 금속 보온병을 쓸 때: Down tube mounting, insulated metal bottles
금속 물통을 가볍게, 스테인리스는 작은 프레임에도: Light metal bottle carry; stainless also suits small frames
날진, 40oz 클린캔틴, 텐트, 침낭: Nalgene, 40oz Klean Kanteen, tents, sleeping bags
바이크패킹, 포크 · 다운튜브 장착: Bikepacking, fork and down tube mounting
사이클링 물통이 아닌 물통은 바닥 지름이 3인치(약 76mm)보다 작아야: Non-cycling bottles must have a base under 3 inches (about 76mm) to fit Iris and Flat Top. Weights are approximate figures from the official King Cage store and may vary slightly between pieces. Not sure which cage suits your bike and bottle? Send photos of both to Rubi Workshop.
서머빌의 공구 작업실에서<br/>듀랑고의 지하 공방까지,<br/>킹 케이:
From a tool shop in Somerville
to a basement workshop in Durango,
the King Cage story.
한 손님의 부탁으로 만든 티타늄 케이지 하나가 30년 넘게 이어진 가족: One titanium cage made at a customer's request became a family workshop that has lasted over 30 years. King Cage never moved to a big factory; it still makes each cage the way it did at the start.
팀 팻 챈스의 MTB 레이서였던 론 앤드루스가 팻 시티 사이클과 아이비스: Ron Andrews, an MTB racer with Team Fat Chance, streamlines frame production at Fat City Cycles and Ibis.
서머빌에서 원오프 티타늄의 마이크 아우그스퍼거와 작업실을 나눠 쓰며 프레: Sharing a shop in Somerville with Mike Augspurger of One-Off Titanium, he makes tools and machines for frame shops.
손님의 부탁으로 첫 티타늄 물통 케이지를 만들고, 그 이름을 킹 케이지라: At a customer's request he makes the first titanium bottle cage and names it the King Cage. Dealer orders follow.
예티 사이클에서 일하기 위해 콜로라도 듀랑고로 옮깁니다. 밤에는 차고에서: He moves to Durango, Colorado to work for Yeti Cycles, making cages in his garage at night.
스테인리스 케이지를 내놓습니다. 이 모양은 지금까지 거의 바뀌지 않았습니: The stainless steel cage arrives. Its shape has barely changed since.
북미 핸드메이드 바이시클 쇼에서 부스에 기계를 놓고 직접 케이지를 구부리: At the North American Handmade Bicycle Show, he sets up machines in the booth and bends cages live for the crowds.
사이드 로더, 아이리스, 매니씽으로 라인업을 넓히고, 가족과 직원들이 함: The range grows with the Side Loader, Iris and Manything, while family and crew keep the Durango basement shop running.
